He is a 2.03 m [[guard-forward]] who currently plays with the Turkish giants [[Fenerbahçe Ülker]].[http://www.fenerbahce.org/fb2008/detay.asp?ContentID=24965 Fenerbahçe Ülker's transfers] He started his basketball career with his hometown club [[HKK Zrinjski Mostar|Zrinjski Mostar]] where he played for 2 years and then played for [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]], [[CB Murcia]] (on loan from Real Madrid) and then last played for [[Cibona Zagreb]].
